However, looking at the diff, the TopicEmbed model in app/models/topic_embed.rb shows that topic_id comes from post.topic_id when creating the embed (line 21-24), so they are always consistent at creation time. The post_id is needed to track which specific post to revise on updates (line 30-35). This is a valid denormalization pattern - storing topic_id allows efficient lookups without joining through posts. The code ensures consistency by always deriving topic_id from the post's topic. There's no actual bug here - the design is intentional and the code maintains the relationship correctly.
